about: Firestone research icons (library, Firestone tab), recorded 2026-09-28 on the owner's 1920x1009 Windows Epic client from trees I..XIII: per name, the median over every maxed (light-blue) box and view. window = (left, top, right, bottom) logical px from the box's top-left corner; thumb = N: an N x N grid of mean RGB, flattened row by row. maxed = the light-blue boxes as seen; available / running = the same icons with their light-blue background pixels replaced by the dark-blue box colour (13, 73, 222) / the gold gradient of a running box, measured on tree XIII. masks = per name, the share of icon pixels in each cell (the pixels that are not the light-blue box colour, median over the same boxes); the rest of a cell is the box's colour, which the bot moves to the box's own before comparing (the Mac's capture reads the dark blue 0x2848D8). Names: the wiki's, with the game's Expose Weakness (wiki Weak Boss) and Weaklings (wiki Weak Enemy). sources = the trees each name was recorded in.
